races.verdict: With plenty of pace in the field, this could set up perfectly for NOTABLE SPEECH to claim a sixth top-level success. Lake Forest is arguably a better horse than when second in this corresponding event 12 months ago, and he's feared along with Rogue Diplomat , who shaped very well when just a neck behind him in the Lennox. Ten Bob Tony is enjoying a fine season and deserves a place on the shortlist for this fascinating renewal. NOTABLE SPEECH LAKE FOREST ROGUE DIPLOMAT (IRE)

races.verdict: DANCE IN THE STORM resumed her impressive progress despite being on the wrong end of the draw again when adding another 7f success to her tally at Chester 3 weeks ago, doing very well having come from last and wide. She's long since suggested a try at sprinting could see her to even better effect and is fancied to prove the point from a 4 lb higher mark. Stewards' Cup scorer Evening Saigon , Wednesday's course winner Air Force One and Pocklington head the dangers. Sondad is another in the mix. DANCE IN THE STORM EVENING SAIGON (IRE) AIR FORCE ONE (IRE)

races.verdict: Low mileage 4-y-o CLOTH OF GOLD did about as well as possible under the circumstances in a better race considering a less-than-ideal trip at Southwell on his most recent outing and is taken to capitalise on this marked drop in grade. Mwafaq continues to thrive and seems sure to be on the premises again with this easy 1¼m likely to be within range. Moonrunner has been freshened up after a poor run at Yarmouth and is also interesting, for all that he may be better suited by a more galloping track. CLOTH OF GOLD (IRE) MWAFAQ (IRE) MOONRUNNER

races.verdict: No shortage of chances but ROMAN DRAGON finds himself back down to his last winning mark having found his stamina stretched tackling 7f on each of his last 2 starts around here and, from a handy draw, he could well be ready to make a bold bid to enhance his already fine record on the Roodee. Easy Wolverhampton scorer American Style , and course specialist Rosenpur head the dangers, whilst a strong pace could bring Cherry Baker into things late in the piece. ROMAN DRAGON AMERICAN STYLE ROSENPUR (GER)

races.display_title: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: A chance is taken on SILIN ALAINN , who hasn’t shown a great deal over hurdles but has a handicap mark to reflect that, and her switch to a top, in-form yard with a good record with similar sorts is well worth taking seriously in what looks a modest handicap hurdle. Uptaurintop arrives in good form and appeals as the one most likely to take advantage should the selection fail to fire, with both Tedworth and The Border Boy also respected. SILIN ALAINN (IRE) UPTAURINTOP (IRE) TEDWORTH (IRE) THE BORDER BOY (IRE)
